# airflow-supervisor

> Apache Airflow integration for supervisord-managed jobs

## Pages

- [airflow-supervisor](index.html.md): Run and monitor supervisord-managed jobs from Apache Airflow.
- [Tutorial: run your first supervised job](docs/src/tutorial.html.md): We will run a five-second job under supervisord, monitor it from Airflow, and remove its configuration when it finishes.
- [How-to guides](docs/src/how-to.html.md): Run jobs on an Airflow worker or a remote SSH host, with configuration in Python or airflow-config YAML.
- [How to forward program logs and check retained services](docs/src/observability.html.md): Forward a program’s stdout and stderr into Airflow task logs during its lifecycle. For services retained between DAG runs, use a separate scheduled health ta...
- [Why Airflow delegates process ownership](docs/src/explanation.html.md): An Airflow task instance owns a worker process for part of a workflow. A job that spawns children or keeps running between DAG runs needs a process manager w...
